visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a black T-shirt with a blue Stitch character, sits in front of a white sofa. She holds a large orange cardboard box with various Disney characters on it. Behind her is a painting on the wall. (2) She opens the large box to reveal eight smaller, individual boxes arranged in two rows. She points at the boxes with a smile. (3) She picks up one small box and opens it, taking out a silver foil bag. She rips the bag open to reveal a Dumbo toy sitting on a green pumpkin base. A small mouse toy is perched on Dumbo's head. (4) She assembles the toy onto a purple base on the table. (5) She opens another box, revealing a Goofy toy dressed as Frankenstein's monster, sitting on a yellow pumpkin. (6) The third box contains a Pluto toy in a black skeleton suit on a green pumpkin. (7) The fourth box contains Chip 'n Dale together on a blue pumpkin, dressed as little devils with horns and tails. (8) The fifth box reveals Donald Duck dressed as a mummy in white bandages on a blue pumpkin. (9) The sixth box contains Stitch dressed as a devil on an orange pumpkin. (10) The woman opens the remaining two boxes, revealing Mickey Mouse in a vampire-like outfit and Minnie Mouse in a witch costume. (11) All eight toys are lined up on the table in front of her as she gestures towards them and claps her hands, concluding the unboxing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a cheerful female voice introducing the Disney Cosbi Collection unboxing. An upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM plays continuously in the background at a moderate volume. (2) A loud tearing sound occurs as the cardboard box is ripped open, followed by the high-pitched crinkling of a foil bag. The female voice expresses excitement, accompanied by a male voice off-screen reacting with a soft 'wow'. (3) A percussive 'click' is heard as a toy is snapped onto its plastic base. The BGM remains steady with a synth-led melody and electronic drums. (4) For each of the subsequent toys, a sequence of tearing, foil crinkling, and plastic clicking sounds repeats, synchronized with the visual transitions. The female narrator describes each character with an animated and friendly tone, her pitch rising when expressing affection for the toys. (5) Short, stylized 'whoosh' and 'ding' sound effects are used between scenes to emphasize the reveal of each new character. (6) In the final phase, the female narrator claps her hands (short rhythmic thuds) while asking the audience's opinion on the collection, her voice maintaining high energy until the track cuts out.
